final_message:
I fixed the following issues in the source code:

1. In bookings/billing.py, I changed billable_blocks to always round up using math.ceil and added a check to raise ValueError if minutes is negative, as required by the docstring.

2. In bookings/schedule.py, I fixed add_slot to avoid using a mutable default argument. It now returns a new list each time, so separate calls do not share state, matching the docstring specification.

3. In bookings/timeutil.py, I extended parse_duration to support all the duration formats listed in the docstring ("1h30m", "2h", "45m", "1:30", "45") instead of only "XhYm".

After these fixes, all tests in the test suite pass successfully.
